highlights: Today keeps its order: while you log, skip or come back to the app, the Needs-care sections stay where they were when you opened Today. Tap By location or By type (even the one already highlighted) to re-sort. A new day starts fresh, and yesterday's logs no longer hide plants that are due again today. Opening a plant and coming back still starts a fresh order.

Frost: after a frost advisory or frost-protect email, once both forecasts for tonight warm out of frost range, Today says so (for example "Forecast warmed to 44°F since the 3 PM frost email.") instead of still showing the email's warning and low. A clear, calm-night "Frost watch" keeps its own line.
Behind the scenes: a bad release can now be undone by a normal follow-up release that keeps all your garden data, and the emergency rewind refuses to go back past 4.156.
